headline: School Committee to vote on updated Operating Protocols and job description for Assistant Director of Special Education.
summary: The School Committee will review subcommittee reports on student activity accounts, special education funding, and job descriptions, then vote on updated Operating Protocols and the Assistant Director of Special Education job description.
items: Technical and Adaptive Change - Initial Entry Plan Update
Program Subcommittee report on School Committee Operating Protocols

Building and Finance Subcommittee report on Student Activity Accounts, GHS Theatre/Drama account creation, FY26 Activity Balances, Special Education FY27 Circuit Breaker Reimbursement, NEC Quarterly Update, Out of District Tuition, Out of District Transportation, Future Meetings Arrangement, and Budget Transfers
Personnel Subcommittee report on updated job descriptions for three non-union contracts
Vote on updated Gloucester School Committee Operating Protocols
Vote to approve job description for Assistant Director of Special Education
location: Gloucester High School Library, 32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930
